Open book (seminar presentation in group/individual – 2 + simulation project)

makeup_policy: Makeup will not be given for quizzes or assignments. Make-up for other components is a one-time provision that applies only in cases of 'extreme medical emergency'. Seasonal fever, allergy, loose motion, vomiting, mood swing, attending celebrations, ceremonies etc do not qualify for make-up.
